name: R077-sleep-talk-thunderbolt-lightning-rod
why: Challenge 7, trainer 200. The player's Regice (839: Ice Beam, Thunderbolt, Sleep Talk, Rest; Chesto Berry) leads against Gardevoir (437, faster, Hypnosis). A first Hypnosis is cured by the Chesto Berry (used up), a second one leaves Regice asleep; Regice's Ice Beams wear Gardevoir down and, once asleep, Sleep Talk calls Thunderbolt against the Lightning Rod foe (Manectric 393 / Rhydon 403) that replaces it: GetMoveTarget's Lightning Rod test runs (battle_util.c:3854-3856; the drawn target is the holder itself in singles, so no redirect).
